# Class: `VideoSequenceFrameSource`

Presents several ordered video clips as one frame sequence.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-frame-source.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_frame_source.py#L780) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `FrameSource`.

Global indexes change if clips are reordered. `frame_reference` and `global_index_for_reference` provide the clip/local-index mapping; preserve this mapping when remapping markers and results.
